title: Route qualification on an objectively labeled family: affected test selection
summary: 40 development cases generated from git history with deterministic labels (171 s, no model call). Routes: deterministic import-graph (incumbent), deterministic select-all, gpt-6-luna @fast, Haiku @fast, Sonnet @balanced; 3 samples per model route (9 calls; one Haiku sample hit the Claude weekly limit). No cheap route qualifies: Luna 0.19 and Haiku 0.15 case pass rate with recall ~0.5 (they under-select). Sonnet is noninferior to the deterministic selector (0.383 vs 0.375) but costs $0.20 and 62 s per run against $0 and 7 s, with lower recall (0.92 vs 0.98). Outcome for the hypothesis 'a cheap model route qualifies': rejected. Outcome for the execution hierarchy: the deterministic rung wins this family; use the import-graph selector (and improve its precision) rather than a model.
